definition.name: TAKSH-KARK-BENCH

pins.karkain_compiler_version: 1.1.0 (windows/amd64, Stable Build; commit e612ede branch feature/v1.2.0-native-independence)
pins.note: every score must reference the exact compiler build it was produced with; scores without a pin are invalid

mode_semantics.model_only: raw model output scored without any compiler or execution assistance; this is the model capability signal
mode_semantics.compiler_assisted: model output compiled by KCC and scored against tests/execution/diagnostics; this is the system capability signal; never reported as model capability

categories.description: lexing/parsing conformance: tokens, declarations, control flow, functions, structs, enums, interfaces, generics, error syntax
name resolution, type checking, ownership/borrow rules, move semantics, generic constraint resolution
end-to-end compile of the program; diagnostics emitted, no false positives, error-code correctness (K000-K999)
KIR v1 emission, structure verification (SSA dominance, phi placement), semantic preservation across lowering
error localization: given broken code, produce the corrected version or correctly identify the defect class
algorithms and data structures: loops, conditionals, arrays/maps/structs, sorting/searching, recursion
standard-library usage: string, collections, math, io, encoding, testing, generics
cross-language translation involving Karkain: other language -> Karkain and Karkain -> other language
multi-file tasks: imports, modules, build files, test discovery, small project evolution
adaptation to new Karkain features: given a new or changed construct, correctly comprehend and use it

task_contract.scoring: unit assertions, equal weight per assertion
contamination_rules: no Karkain benchmark task may appear in any training corpus without explicit owner sign-off
Karkain conformance corpus (conformance/*.kark) may be used ONLY as references for schema validation, never as training targets or answer keys

qualification_bar.model_only: NOT DEFINED YET — bar must be set before evaluation, never after results are seen
qualification_bar.compiler_assisted: NOT DEFINED YET — bar must be set before evaluation, never after results are seen
qualification_bar.rule: no threshold may be lowered after observing results; any qualification requires FUNCTIONALLY_QUALIFIED or ENGINEERING_QUALIFIED status in the dynamic registry

versioning.frozen: alteration requires explicit owner sign-off and a new version; older results remain valid against the schema version they were collected under
